status_legend.probe_ok: bounded direct response and reconnaissance parsing succeeded; not a production or accuracy verdict
status_legend.probe_tls_failed: local verified-TLS request failed; no certificate bypass
status_legend.primary_page: publisher page or documentation inspected; actual local feed not validated
status_legend.lead: discovery lead; not independently verified in this pass
status_legend.dead: published once, then abandoned; the last-update date is recorded
status_legend.no_coverage: confirmed absent for Belgrade or Serbia; recorded so nobody repeats the search
status_legend.opted_out: the publisher has refused automated collection, by robots.txt, Content-Signal or terms; recorded with the clause so it is never proposed again
status_legend.collected: raw files retrieved, stored immutably under research/evidence/ with a manifest and hashes, and parsed into a derived table; permission documented in research/08-provenance/ before collection
status_legend.token_required: the service exists and its index is public, but every dataset requires a token we do not have and did not seek; the names are recorded so nobody rediscovers them
status_legend.restricted: terms permit access but forbid the redistribution the project depends on; recorded with the clause
status_legend.account_required: an account is needed and it has not been established that the account is instant self-service; outside v1 under the depends-on-nobody rule
status_legend.needs_decision: the capture completed but the letter and the evident intent of the rule diverge; held open in research/08-provenance/EDGE_CASES.md and NOT collected until a decision is recorded there
status_legend.blocked: robots.txt permits, but the server refuses our identified agent (e.g. HTTP 403). Not an opt-out; not access either. Recorded with the status code and never worked around.
status_legend.paid: exists and is offered commercially; the price is recorded where published. Outside v1, inside the census.
status_legend.request_required: exists, obtainable only by writing to a named body. Outside v1 by the depends-on-nobody rule, recorded in full.
status_legend.exists_unpublished: the instrument or dataset demonstrably exists - a tender, a licence, a paper, a project document names it - and is published nowhere.
status_legend.exists_via_literature: known only through a publication that used it.
status_legend.sought_not_found: we believe it should exist, we searched, we did not find it. Always carries what was searched, where, when and with what terms, because this is a claim about our method and must be falsifiable.
